column1: # P6a FROZEN 2026-07-27. Closed grammatical classes (standard grammars).
# Excluded as ambiguous: fr 'on' (impersonal); it 'ci' (locative). Elision rule frozen:
# tokenizer splits apostrophes; bare 'j'/'m' prefixes count as je/me (fr).
